technicalProjects.title: Telemetry Collector / Analyzer
technicalProjects.description: Built a real-time pipeline for racing-simulator telemetry, moving data from a Python collector through a Go service into a Unity-based analysis interface.
bullets: Collected live simulator data through a custom Python plugin.
Used a Go server to store and transfer telemetry to a frontend application.
Visualized vehicle position on a virtual track with supporting charts for analysis.

technicalProjects.title: Autonomous Racing Agent
technicalProjects.description: Built a reinforcement learning racing agent using Soft Actor-Critic to autonomously drive Assetto Corsa from simulator telemetry.
bullets: Trained a PyTorch SAC agent to hot lap Monza in the BMW Z4 GT3 using raw simulator telemetry rather than vision or map input.
Engineered a real-time pipeline that syncs model inference to 30 Hz physics packets read through shared memory.
Injected steering, throttle, brake, and gear-control outputs through a ViGEmBus virtual gamepad driver.
Documented 14+ training runs, including reward-shaping experiments, behavior cloning attempts, and a best valid lap of 1:54.127.

technicalProjects.title: Realtime Procedural Generation
technicalProjects.description: Built a continuous terrain generation system that streams 3D environment data during play without major performance stutter.
bullets: Generated terrain at runtime with responsive chunk updates.
Focused on smooth frame behavior while new world data entered the scene.

gameProjects.title: The Walls Weren't Always Red
gameProjects.description: A puzzle-horror concept with evolving color-based navigation and tension pacing.
bullets: Built and polished a playable puzzle-horror concept under jam constraints.
Focused on readable interaction loops, pacing, and responsive Unity implementation.

gameProjects.title: Photophobic Teyeme
gameProjects.description: A dark ambient prototype where fear mechanics and uncertainty shape every play decision.
bullets: Implemented interactive horror mechanics that react to player movement and visibility.
Tuned atmosphere and feedback loops for rapid prototype playability.

gameProjects.title: RALCOOP
gameProjects.description: A co-op experiment focused on synced timing and team-driven movement loops.
bullets: Built team-oriented movement interactions for a playable co-op prototype.
Collaborated on scope and implementation during a short production cycle.

gameProjects.title: Unstable

bullets: Implemented escalating gameplay behavior around changing system states.
Balanced moment-to-moment feedback for a compact playable loop.
